title: Let My Voices Take Over (And Overwhelm You) (Xtra Induction)
description: You know it's how I want this to end, how I want you to end — with my voices taking over your mind — and you want it too, don't deny it. Just accept it, and enjoy it, and take what I have to give you. Breathe in the joy. Let out your stress. Sinking deep into trance, into deep relaxation and whispered bliss. As each of my soft words drifts and covers your mind. As each of my jolting snaps spikes and pulls at your focus. Overwhelming you from every side. And if you can? — Follow them. Try to follow my voice, and obey my commands. Try to follow my snaps, and embrace the sexual pleasures of their tingling waves.
author: Mistress Shibby
